taxon_rule: the first GAF taxon is the gene-product taxon and must equal taxon:9606
negative_annotation_use: NOT rows are excluded from positives and do not become training negatives
ontology_source: go-basic.obo from the same dated official GO release as the human annotations
alternate_id_policy: resolve explicit alt_id entries to an active primary GO term
obsolete_and_unknown_term_policy: exclude and audit; no replacement inference
identifier_mapping: exact UniProtKB accession to Approved HGNC uniprot_ids to stable Ensembl gene ID, then exact GENCODE universe join
ambiguous_identifier_policy: exclude globally one-to-many UniProtKB-to-gene mappings before universe intersection and retain them in an audit
evaluation_universe: GENCODE v50 protein_coding and lncRNA genes on chr1-22 and chrX, 54710 genes
split_policy: reuse the existing label-free split without label-driven reassignment
lncrna_support_policy: report observed experimental support separately; protein annotations are not transferred to lncRNAs
next_gate: independent source/ID/ontology replay and GO-specific provenance admission before any GO model fitting
